caption: The drawing features a single wooden wall cabinet, depicted in a three-dimensional perspective against a plain, light beige background with faint visible marks and outlines. The cabinet is medium brown in color and has a rectangular shape with a door on the front, secured by two metal hinges on the right and a metal keyhole plate on the left. The door displays some signs of wear, such as small pale patches and the appearance of wood grain. Below the main door, there is a small rectangular drawer with a central round knob. The bottom edge of the cabinet has a decorative scalloped trim. The light source appears to be coming from the left side, as indicated by the shading on the right and underside of the cabinet. There is no visible ornamentation other than the functional hardware and scalloped lower edge.
title: Wall Cabinet
